title: Witch's Magic Cart — Tens and Ones
description: Make a three-ingredient potion with trays of ten and single apples, dragon eggs and purple frogs. Choose a number range, a specific number list, ingredient order or a fixed target, with spoken requests, sound and desktop-friendly celebrations.
learning_intent: Represent numbers to 100 using groups of ten and ones, understanding that one group of ten has the same value as ten individual objects.
